defects.defect: The statement 'View All Data and Modify All Data do not grant field access' is labelled 'verified by org query', but it is documented platform behavior. It is correct, but it carries the wrong evidence label.
defects.skill_gap: SKILL.md's evidence-label rule (platform behavior must be tagged 'assumption (documented platform behavior)') covers this; it was applied inconsistently.

defects.defect: Adding the action to the shared Case-Case Layout shows a button that fails for every profile without Issue_Case_Refunds, including System Administrator, whose profile has no Refund__c FieldPermissions. The spec acknowledges this and recommends keeping it, but it is poor UX for a known-failing path.
defects.skill_gap: None exists. SKILL.md does not cover placing actions on layouts shared by users who lack the access the action needs.
